_comment: EXP-21 PolyServe. Same mix A (1:1:1) as EXP-14/17 so the arms stay comparable.
The SLO block is what the client packs into the OpenAI 'priority' field as
ttft_ms*1000 + tbt_ms, which the Llumnix gateway unpacks into the per-request
TTFT/TPOT budgets. tbt_ms doubles as the PolyServe TIER KEY, so every class
states it explicitly here: swe would otherwise inherit DEFAULT_TBT_MS and its
tier could drift silently if that default ever changed.
swe's 11800ms is the EXP-17 conversion of its 30s end-to-end budget
(30000 - 728 tokens * 25 ms), so attainment stays judged on the same basis.
